{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''spaceport''', located in [[Jesart desert]] far from any [[Human/Legends|human]] settlement, was [[Eliad]]'s primary and only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. It was heavily guarded by 800 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that searched every [[Starship/Legends|ship]] leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], ensuring that none of the nobles exiled on the world by [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor]] attempted to leave. Despite the careful work that was done at departures, ships were rarely searched at arrival.

Since the planet was completely under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control, an Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] ruled it from the [[Imperial Consulate (Eliad)|Imperial Consulate]] that had been established in the spaceport
